description:
# Teal & Gold Rustic Wood – Digital Seamless Pattern Collection
Bring rustic elegance and modern sophistication to your creative projects with this **Teal & Gold Rustic Wood Digital Seamless Pattern Collection**. Featuring weathered wooden planks, distressed wood grain textures, luxurious gold accents, rustic painted finishes, natural timber details, and seamless repeating patterns in rich shades of teal, turquoise, weathered blue, metallic gold, warm brown, and soft neutral tones, this collection beautifully blends farmhouse charm with contemporary luxury.
Inspired by reclaimed wood, coastal cottages, rustic farmhouse décor, modern interiors, artisan craftsmanship, and contemporary surface pattern design, these high-resolution seamless digital papers are perfect for fabric printing, stationery, scrapbooking, home décor, branding, and print-on-demand products.
## ✨ Perfect For
• Scrapbooking & Memory Albums
• Greeting Cards & Invitations
• Planner Covers & Stickers
• Journaling & Paper Crafts
• Fabric & Textile Design

• Surface Pattern Design
• DIY Crafts & Handmade Gifts
• Print-on-Demand Products
• Small Business Branding
• Luxury Product Packaging
• Commercial Creative Projects
## 📦 What You’ll Receive
• High-resolution JPG digital papers
• 300 DPI professional print quality
• Seamless repeating rustic wood patterns
• Coordinated teal and gold distressed wood designs
• Instant digital download
• Ready for both print and digital use
## 💖 Why You’ll Love It
• Realistic rustic wood grain with elegant gold accents
• Sophisticated teal and metallic-inspired color palette
• Seamless repeating patterns for flawless large-scale designs

• Easy to resize and customize

• Files are watermark-free.
